rule: Apply a field only if the study's current text for that field equals 'before'. Then replace it with 'after'.

theology.before: The verse shows people treating Jesus with contempt at the very moment he is being condemned. Christians read this scene as part of the Gospel's larger story of a king whose kingdom is not what the mockers imagine. The Gospels remember Jesus being mocked as a king in several places. Matthew 27:28-30 describes a similar mockery with a purple robe and a crown of thorns. John 19:2-5 shows Jesus brought out wearing these things before the crowd. Luke 23:11 describes Herod and his soldiers mocking him with a robe.
